SEARCH

Uses of Package
io.webagent4j.observation

Packages that use io.webagent4j.observation
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.action
Verified browser actions: one explicit, bounded command pipeline per interaction, with three terminal modes - real execution, dryRun(), and plan() - that all share the exact same target-resolution and precondition logic so they can never disagree.
io.webagent4j.browser
Backend-neutral browser, page, and frame contracts - no Playwright (or other native backend) type appears in any public signature here.
io.webagent4j.browsercrawler.internal
Engine internals for BrowserCrawler: the FIFO frontier, the synchronized claim gate, scope evaluation, DOM link discovery, page stability waiting, and URL normalization.
io.webagent4j.observation
The immutable semantic observation model, options, renderers, diff, fingerprint, and the batch-capture backend SPI (io.webagent4j.observation.spi) - depends on webagent4j-dom and webagent4j-locator-api only, never on a browser backend.
io.webagent4j.observation.internal
 
io.webagent4j.observation.spi
 
io.webagent4j.verification
Deterministic, side-effect-free, pollable conditions over current page state - used both as action postconditions (IPreparedAction#expect(...)) and standalone.
